name: Pete Buttigieg

lean.basis: Democratic mayor of South Bend, 2020 presidential candidate and Biden's transportation secretary.

race_2028.basis: Tops several 2028 Democratic primary polls, especially in New Hampshire and Minnesota, and is openly raising his profile.

summary: Pete Buttigieg, a Navy reserve veteran, was mayor of South Bend, Indiana, ran for the 2020 Democratic nomination, and served as Joe Biden's transportation secretary from 2021 to 2025. His successor Sean Duffy has repeatedly blamed him for air-traffic-control failures. He leads several 2028 primary polls.
